## Specifications

- **(12) M205 Halfshaft Flange bolts/nuts**: #39606-17V0A [t248] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)
- **(2) new 32mm halfaxle/hub nuts**: #40262-A60001 [t248] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)
- **(3) 19mm Diff/Frame Bolts (use new nuts for two)**: #54726-7S000 [t248] ([Unverified] single report)
- **(8) 14mm front DS bolts/nuts**: #37120-4P00A [t248] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Do not reuse the old 19mm Diff/Frame bolts; buy new ones with specific nuts. [t248]
- Note that two of the three 19mm frame bolts use separate nuts, while the third uses a nut welded into the frame. [t248]
